description: Summarize today, goal gaps, wearable context, and a safe next action for Telegram-style coaching.

auto_wearable.description: If true and no wearable_context is passed inline, try to read the most recent shared wellness_context from ~/.delx-wellness/ (written by a wearable connector). The coach reports whether a context was actually found; it never fabricates wearable data. Inline wearable_context always wins over the auto-pulled one.
